summary: The decode count, timing correction, and CLI checks address the prior findings. The new playback check can miss the first Rune Match effect.
blocking_findings: F4 [Blocker] review-c: scripts/audio-budget.mjs:201-211,310-317 sets the effect marker after Start and the canvas click. Rune Match plays its opening effect from scene creation, so the filter can discard a valid opening file start and fail on later music. Set the marker before the launch action and distinguish effects from music.
